appearance_facts.fact: The title 'Renewable Energy Production by Source' is centered at the top of the page.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Reported production share (%)' and displays a scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks every 5 units.
The horizontal axis lists five source categories: Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, Biomass, and Geothermal.
The first bar is yellow and extends vertically to a level just above the 40 mark on the y-axis.
The second bar is light blue and is the tallest mark on the page, extending vertically to a level just below the 70 mark.
The third bar is medium blue and extends vertically to a level between the 50 and 55 marks.
The fourth bar is green and is the shortest mark on the page, extending vertically to a level between the 20 and 25 marks.
The fifth bar is brown and extends vertically to a level just above the 35 mark.

printed_facts.fact: The text '41.2%' is printed directly above the yellow bar.
The text '29.8%' is printed directly above the light blue bar.
The text '18.5%' is printed directly above the medium blue bar.
The text '7.2%' is printed directly above the green bar.
The text '3.3%' is printed directly above the brown bar.
The y-axis is labeled 'Reported production share (%)'.

public_definitions: Routing criterion: Largest renewable generation contribution source
uncertain: The printed numeric labels (e.g., 41.2%, 29.8%) do not correspond to the visual heights of the bars (e.g., the 41.2% bar is visually shorter than the 29.8% bar).
It is unclear whether the 'largest contribution source' refers to the visual height of the bars or the magnitude of the printed percentage labels.
